name: Pledge Weave
description: Weave a pledge into a cord of qi so the foe feels the promise as a weight.

name: Pact Mirror
description: Raise a guard held up by a compact that turns the harm of a blow back on the breaker.

name: Held Faith
description: Bind a company of allies to a shared faith so that none of them wavers.

name: Contract Snare
description: Lay a snare written as a contract that closes on any who agree to its terms by stepping in.

name: Compact Seal
description: Seal a foe's technique under the terms of a compact the foe has already half accepted.

name: Covenant Chain
description: Chain a mighty foe to a covenant whose every link is a promise the foe has made.

name: Binding Flash
description: Flash along a bond to its other end in less than a heartbeat.

name: Oath Absorption
description: Draw the force of a blow into the oath that binds the user and let the oath bear it.

name: Great Compact
description: The school's own compact that binds and seals a foe together with a weight scaled to the user's reserve.

name: Compact Tempest
description: The school's own storm of compacts that takes every foe in reach and holds each to its terms.

name: Compact Collapse
description: Call every broken promise in a region to bind and crush at once up to the ceiling of a Core-tier binder.

name: Kept Promise
description: Make a spoken promise a fact of the world; no cultivation mechanic explains why a word becomes a bond that cannot be broken.
